headline: Vinataba Profit Up 62% in First Six Months, Nearly 7,000 Billion Dong Deposited in Banks
summary: Vinataba reported first-half 2026 net revenue of 17,223 billion dong, up 11.8%, and profit after tax of 1,339 billion dong, up 61.6%. Cash and short-term deposits reached nearly 6,927 billion dong.
why: Vinataba is a large Vietnamese state-owned conglomerate, and its results reflect the health of state enterprises that investors track in Vietnam's listed and unlisted market.
